candidate_sentences.text: During the twelve-month period ended 31 December 2025, Nordecon AS recorded consolidated revenue of 208,281 thousand euros, representing a decrease of approximately 7% compared to 223,925 thousand euros in 2024.
Gross profit for 2025 was 13,535 thousand euros, resulting in a gross margin of 6.5%, down from 7.5% in 2024.
Operating profit stood at 5,651 thousand euros, yielding an operating margin of 2.7% compared to 3.6% in the prior year.
Consequently, the group ended the reporting period with a net profit of 2,545 thousand euros, compared to 5,165 thousand euros in 2024.

Net finance costs rose to 2,965 thousand euros, heavily impacted by a foreign exchange loss of 750 thousand euros resulting from the 12% weakening of the Ukrainian hryvnia against the euro during the translation of loans provided to Ukrainian subsidiaries.
